dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Damn it, Narancia!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Who do you think you are, trying to eat all the chocolates yourself?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Give them back!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I bought them with my own money, so give them back!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Narancia, I swear...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: There are only three left!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What a greedy little sh*t.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: We've all been waiting for these, and we're hungry!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: The ladybug brooch is moving from the top of the tower.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I can feel it.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It's heading to the charnel house below

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: to try to cross through there.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati must've put the brooch somewhere on the boss's clothes.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Sorry, Giorno, but could you grab that water?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: I'm a bit thirsty.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Also, you should be careful.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: We've been ordered to wait here on the boat for now,

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: and not set foot on the island.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Right.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Huh? Eh?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Y-You ate them, didn't you, Mista?!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Give them back, damn it!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: And what the hell do you have on your mouth?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Huh?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Ah!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: "Ah," my a*s! You little sh*t!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: S-So sweet!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: When did you stuff them in your mouth?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: By the way, I didn't thank you yet, did I, Giorno?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: For grabbing the water.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Something's... bizarre...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I don't know what,

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: but something's strange.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Hey, you b*stard!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Didn't you hear that the boss ordered us not to set foot on the is—

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: ...land?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Huh?!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This isn't normal.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Something weird is going on!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This isn't good! Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Where do you think you're going, Giorno?!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Is that you, Giorno?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Yes, I know he's on the move.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I know exactly where the boss is because of the brooch you put on him.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Right now, he's at the bottom of the stairs to the charnel house.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: He's right by the pillar that's about two meters away from the stairs.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: But wait, Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Something is wrong!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, your mission to act as Trish's bodyguard

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: has now come to an end.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Wh-Why, you...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: He's trying to immobilize my arm.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Zipper Man!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: But... Emperor Crimson has already...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: ...seen through it.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Your movements in the future.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: The trajectory of your movements in the future.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Within Emperor Crimson's ability, this world's time disappears,

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: and no one remembers the movements they made within this segment of time.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: The clouds in the sky don't realize they've broken apart.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: A flame that's extinguished doesn't even realize the moment it went out.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: All that remains in this world are the results.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: In the world where time has been eliminated, all movement becomes pointless!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I am the only one who can react to these movements.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I can see every single one of your movements!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: This is Emperor Crimson's ability!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Th-This ability...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: No matter who you may be,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: everyone goes through their ups and downs.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: You succeed, and you fail.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: But if you happen to find the pitfall known as the future that's right in front of you

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: and manage to not fall in,

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: you will never experience a setback in your life.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: You will remain in your best condition.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Don't you think so?

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Now that I've actually met you, I can tell that we are indeed related.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I can sense that you are, without a doubt, my daughter.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Which means...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: When you are awake, you will feel the exact same way toward me!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Trish...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I must fill any pitfall that threatens my path!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I will now sever this bond of blood that binds us!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Trish!

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: {\c&HEFFF&\c&HAEE&}Dogyuuuuun

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: {\c&HEFFF&\c&HAEE&\clip(m l )}Dogyuuuuun

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Wh-What?!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That must be Giorno...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Giorno's Golden Wind's ability...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: He planted the turtle's cells in the brooch and gave it life,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: and a turtle with Stand abilities was born.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Since our call was interrupted, he must've sensed something was wrong

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: and activated his ability.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: He always gives me courage...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I didn't think I could move anymore, but... Not yet.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I still...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: have to keep moving a little bit more.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: My mission's done? You're wrong, Boss.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's still ongoing!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: As for Trish...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I will protect her on my own order!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: If he can read all of my attacks,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: and I can't even realize that he's dodged them,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: then his ability surpasses all others in its invincibility.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This ability doesn't allow him to read one's movements for long!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's only a short time.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It seems to be around five to ten seconds.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Distance...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: For now, I need to get as far away as possible!

dialogue.name: Burno
dialogue.speech: I need to get far enough that the boss can't find Trish!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I beg of you to keep moving, body.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Don't let me waste this chance that Giorno gave me!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Until I can get out of this basement...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: It seems there was another traitor.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Must be the newbie.

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: Rumble

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: If my information is correct, I believe his name is Giorno Giovanna.

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: Rumble

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: So he must've joined this organization with the intent to betray me from the start.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: It seems you thought you could escape just by distancing yourself from me,

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: but it's nothing for me to escape that turtle an instant sooner.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: It appears that your efforts were futile, Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: How are you still able to move?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Sheer willpower?

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: If you just rest, you won't be able to get to the first floor,

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: but you'll be able to die peacefully.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: First, I'm going to eliminate Trish.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Don't you dare move, Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The chance that Giorno gave me wasn't in vain!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: If this is going to be about reading each other's moves,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I've already read yours!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I knew before you fell into the sewer

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: that you'd probably use your ability to escape!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Now, Zipper Man!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Emperor Crimson!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: That was close...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: But within Emperor Crimson's world,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: your efforts are still futile!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Take this!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: You're finished!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It wasn't you that I was trying to attack!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It was this pillar!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Zipper, close!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: What?!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: As I thought... Your ability is invincible...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But it appears that you can only read movements for a short time.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You're not reading ahead of time.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Just try and read my future movements, Boss.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Try to figure out what I'm going to do in a few seconds.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Try to see beyond time.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You should be able to see me

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: after I've reached the first floor.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati! Trish!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This wound...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: What happened in the basement?!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Where's the boss?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: He should still be around...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Somewhere close by.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I don't know the whole situation, but there's no way

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: the boss is just going to let Bucciarati go after this!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: N-No...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: His pulse...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I-Impossible! It's gone!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: I created the parts needed for his recovery!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, please breathe!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: So this must be Giorno Giovanna.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: His unknown ability gave Bucciarati the chance to escape.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: However...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I will not let them get away!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: This is impossible!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I know I created the parts!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: There's no way he shouldn't have a heartbeat!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Giorno, it's me.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Call Abbacchio and the others.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Get out of here.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That voice...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I told you to call Abbacchio and the others.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Get out of here!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Out of this church!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Hurry!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: B-Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Th-Thank goodness!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: You're okay!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Hurry! Hurry up and call the others!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: B-But...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: We can't figure out who the boss actually is right now.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: We need to get out of here, Giorno! While we're still far enough from him!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: They're within my range!

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Here I go!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'll explain later! Hurry up, Giorno!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Golden Wind!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Giorno's over there!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Hey, Giorno, you b*stard! Come back here!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: How are you gonna make up for disobeying orders and stepping onto the island?!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati's here, too!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: H-How the hell did you get so injured?!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Why do you still have Trish with you?!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What's going on here, Bucciarati?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'll explain everything later.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Right now, we need to get out of here as fast as we can.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I commend you, Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I commend your precise and keen decision making.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Even though I have the ability to eliminate time,

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: if I were to face all six of those Stand users,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: one of them would end up learning my true identity.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: For the moment,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: they've managed to escape my Emperor Crimson.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: But this is not the end.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I will never...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: let you escape

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: from Venice!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Now I understand why the boss is feared by everyone and how he ruled over all of us.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: We can't defeat the boss... not now.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: As for his identity...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Assuming it even has one,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: we'll need to find his ability's weakness first!

dialogue.name: Sign
dialogue.speech: Emperor Crimson

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What the hell's going on, Bucciarati?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: We need an explanation.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: What the hell are you doing?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: All right. I'll just come out and say it.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But I can't explain everything right now,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: because there's no time and danger's right around the corner.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The reason I brought Trish back

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: is because I betrayed the boss just now.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'll be leaving you guys now.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: If you go with me, you will also become traitors.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Wh-What?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I-I don't think I heard you right...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Wh-What did you just say?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: He said... he betrayed the boss.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: B-But why?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You probably shouldn't hear any more,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: because you guys have nothing to do with this.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: I think you should explain.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Some of them might want to follow you.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: We need people on our side.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What the hell is your deal, Giorno?!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: First, you go into the church without permission, and now—

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: What's wrong? Are you all right?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'm fine.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: I lost a lot of blood, so I got a bit dizzy.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: That shouldn't be possible...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: When I created his parts, it should've also replenished the blood he lost.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Did I miss a wound?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I guess I've used up a good deal of energy.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Does he not feel pain? There was no blood coming from the wound, either.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Was I just seeing things?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'm sorry.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: You had me worried for a sec!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: For real.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati, please...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Yeah, Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: We want to know the details.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The boss had us act as her bodyguards

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: so that he could k*ll his daughter with his own two hands.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Because she shares his blood, she could have figured out his true identity.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I found that out and...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I couldn't forgive him.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I couldn't just come backpretending I didn't see that.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That's why I betrayed him!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: How could you?

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Are you insane, Bucciarati?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: You know exactly what happens to traitors,

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: no matter who it is.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: The boss never lets anyone get away!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Hell, Venice could already be surrounded by the boss's elite guard!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You're right, and that's why I'm going to need help.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: If any of you are willing to accompany me,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: come down these stairs and get on the boat.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But I will not order any of you to come with me.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I won't even ask you to come with me.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I did this all on my own.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: So you don't need to feelobligated to come with me.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: This may come off as arrogant, but I'm going to say it anyway.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I did this because I believe I'm right.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I have no regrets.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Despite the world we live in, I want to continue on the path that I believe in.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: If we can just find his weakness...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Though we're only fleeing for now,

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I will defeat the boss, no matter what.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I will find his weakness, no matter what!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: I understand your reasons, and what you did was right, Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: But I'm going to be blunt...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: I hate to say it, but no one's going to get on that boat.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: How could you let your emotions take over like that?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: I owe you my life, but going with you now would be a different matter.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: You've lost sight of reality.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: No one can survive in this world on expectations alone.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: We can't survive without the organization.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Fugo's absolutely right.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: What you did is basically suicide.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: No matter where in the world you might run to,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: you'll never find a safe haven again.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Besides, I pledged my loyalty to the organization.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: It's not like I pledged my loyalty to you.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: That being said...

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I never had a home or place I wanted to go.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: The only time I'm ever at ease

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: is when I'm with you, Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: Giorno
dialogue.speech: Abbacchio...

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Y-You can't be serious, Abbacchio!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: If we actually manage to defeat the boss...

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Considering my skills,

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: I'd say I'm next in line to become a capo.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati's smart.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: He never goes into a fight that he has no chance of winning.

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: We're gonna strike it rich for sure.

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Mista! Not you, too!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: What are you going to do, Fugo?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: You've all l-lost your minds!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: We're going to be completely isolated!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Where are you going to run to?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: No, you won't even make it out of Venice alive!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Narancia,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: what are you going to do?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I-I... d-don't know what to do...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Tell me, Bucciarati...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: What should I do?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Do you think I should go?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Are you scared?

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Yeah... I'm r-really scared...

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: B-But just order me!
